notes.subject: הַכַּפֹּרֶת
notes.rationale: Kaporet appears only in the description of the Ark cover, never elsewhere in ordinary usage.

notes.subject: כפרת / כפר
notes.rationale: kaporet shares the root כפר (to cover/atone), linking the covering cloud to atonement, lost in 'mercy seat'.

notes.subject: וכסה
notes.rationale: Read as past 'the cloud covered' (JPS 'may cover' is purpose); the waw-consecutive suggests narrative sequence.

translation: Na akĩigua kĩhembo kĩa makũrũ kana ciumbe cĩa thĩ yĩgĩthiĩ igũrũ thĩ yonthe na mwaki mũnene wa kũhĩtũka, arĩtikĩrire mũthenya ũcio o ũguo Yahwe amwĩtire, na o ũguo Yahwe ũmwe.
